subject: Telemetry gateway partner kickoff: Datadog + Grafana integration
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@datadogpartners.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: telemetry gateway + Datadog / Grafana collaboration

Hi Marcus,

Quick intro from Datadog Strategic Alliances — we heard from a mutual contact (Asha at ObservabilityCo) that Redwood is exploring a lightweight telemetry gateway to unify traces/metrics/logs from your inference runtime. Datadog is interested in a joint pilot that wires your gateway into Datadog APM + Logs, and we can also work with Grafana Labs on dashboarding and long-term visualization.

High-level ask: can we set a 30–45 minute kickoff next week to align on telemetry formats (OpenTelemetry), retention/SLO expectations, and a mutual action plan (MAP)? We can bring one of our integration engineers and a partner PM.

Proposed agenda:
- quick intros + goals (5m)
- data contract: OTLP endpoints, sample payloads (10m)
- metrics/traces/logs routing & retention (10m)
- sample dashboards & alerting SLOs (10m)
- next steps & owners (5m)

A few times that work for our team: Tue 9/8 9am PST, Wed 9/9 11am PST, Thu 9/10 2pm PST. LMK what works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attaching a short partner brief.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connell
Partner Solutions, Datadog Strategic Alliances
liam.oconnell@datadogpartners.com
Attachment: datadog-partner-brief.pdf (1 page)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@datadogpartners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: telemetry gateway + Datadog / Grafana collaboration

Thanks Liam — excited to explore this. Looping in Marissa (partner ops), Jonas (integration lead), and Vanessa (solutions).

We're aligned on OpenTelemetry as the canonical contract. A couple of quick notes from our side before the call:
- We prefer an OTLP/gRPC endpoint for traces and metrics; logs can be pushed via HTTPS or forwarded from the gateway.
- We need to confirm token/KMS workflow for any ingestion keys (security requirement).
- Target for pilot: ingest baseline traffic for 2 model families, retain metrics/traces for 30d, logs for 90d.

Suggested kickoff agenda (short):
- Introductions & success criteria (5m)
- Telemetry contract: OTLP payloads, auth, sampling (12m)
- Ingestion endpoints & capacity (10m)
- Dashboards/alerts & Grafana collaboration (8m)
- MAP & owners (5m)

We have a rough mutual action plan draft — attaching (redwood-mapp-v1.xlsx) and a short proposal PDF (redwood-datadog-grafana-connector-proposal.pdf). Please add any items.

From your proposed times, Tue 9/8 9am PST works for Jonas and me. Vanessa is flexible. Marissa will coordinate logistics. Can you confirm and include the Grafana contact if they want to join?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Developer Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-datadog-grafana-connector-proposal.pdf (5 pages), redwood-mapp-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@datadogpartners.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: telemetry gateway + Datadog / Grafana collaboration

Thanks for looping me in. A few commercial/operational items to flag before the pilot kickoff:
- Data retention & egress: we’ll need an estimate of expected monthly ingest (tokens/GB) for pricing and to size Dedicated ingest capacity.
- SLOs: please confirm desired latency percentile for trace submission (p50/p95) and acceptable sampling rate for traces during peak.
- Security: Datadog/Grafana will need to sign our standard non-prod DPA for the pilot if any customer data flows through their systems.

I updated the MAP with provisional owners and a timeline through the pilot (see redwood-mapp-v1.xlsx tab "Owners"). Jonas - can you add an initial runbook for failure modes (gateway backpressure, auth failures)?

Marissa Cole
Partner Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-mapp-v1.xlsx (updated)

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@grafana.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@datadogpartners.com>
Cc: Amit Patel <amit.patel@grafana.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: telemetry gateway + Datadog / Grafana collaboration

Hi Marcus / Liam,

Grafana Labs is happy to join the kickoff — thanks for including us. A few quick items from our side:
- We have a Grafana Cloud plugin that can ingest OTLP metric streams and map them to templated dashboards; we can provide dashboard templates for model-level latency, token distribution, KV cache hit rate, and aggregation by model version.
- For security, our recommended pattern for pilots is to use short-lived ingestion tokens + IP allow-listing for the gateway. We can sign the DPA; please send it to legal@grafana.com.
- Technical contact for integration: Amit Patel (cc’d) will join the kickoff and can review sample OTLP payloads beforehand if you share them.

Quick link: https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/otlp-ingest (dashboard plugin docs)

Proposed: join Tue 9/8 9am PST — Amit and I can make that.

Best,
Priya Shah
Strategic Partnerships, Grafana Labs
priya.shah@grafana.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@datadogpartners.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@grafana.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@grafana.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: telemetry gateway + Datadog / Grafana collaboration

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Tue 9/8 9:00am PST. Calendar invite sent (Zoom). Agenda attached in the invite (same MAP document). Quick prep notes:
- Jonas, please post 1–2 sample OTLP traces + metrics (sanitized) to the shared Drive link before 5pm PST today so Amit/Datadog can validate mapping.
- Marissa will run through the pilot milestones & legal checklist at the top of the call.
- Liam / Priya — please have the integration engineer present to confirm ingestion auth patterns and dashboard templates.

If anyone needs a different time, shout now; otherwise see you Tuesday.
